```{r}
#| label: setup-trust
#| include: false
# The data of the immigration-and-trust case and the figures drawn from them,
# read once for every segment of the case. Comes after the shared setup chunk
# and uses its palette, theme and number formats. The files and their
# codebooks are in cases/trust/data/, written by R/trust/ (menu_options.csv by
# hand); every number on the slides is computed from them or taken from
# _planning/trust/trust-facts.md. Estimates are in points of distrust (0–10)
# per point of concern about immigration (0–10), and an estimate above zero is
# the direction of the claim.
td <- \(f) file.path("../cases/trust/data", f)
rd <- \(f) read_csv(td(f), show_col_types = FALSE)

# The addresses of the case, which the shared segments print. The record of
# Multi100 lists a source-data reproduction for this paper, so it is not one
# of the nine papers whose reproduction was never attempted, and the SCORE
# slide of Part 1 must not say that it is.
case_vars <- yaml::read_yaml("../_variables.yml")$cases$trust |>
  c(list(`multi100-repro-never-attempted` = FALSE))

# The extract, and the respondents of the paper: citizens who do not belong to
# an ethnic minority. Concern is the mean of the three items, for respondents
# who answered all three, as in Task 2 of the workspace.
ess <- rd("trust_ess.csv")
paper_rows <- ess |>
  filter(citizen %in% 1, minority %in% 0) |>
  mutate(concern = (imm_econ + imm_culture + imm_place) / 3)
n_country_rounds <- n_distinct(paste(ess$cntry, ess$essround))
miss_income <- mean(is.na(paper_rows$hh_income_z))

country_names <- c(AT = "Austria", BE = "Belgium", CH = "Switzerland", DE = "Germany",
                   DK = "Denmark", ES = "Spain", FI = "Finland", FR = "France",
                   GB = "United Kingdom", GR = "Greece", IE = "Ireland", IT = "Italy",
                   NL = "Netherlands", NO = "Norway", PT = "Portugal", SE = "Sweden")

# The association of concern with distrust of parliament within each country,
# and across the 16 country means (unweighted)
r_within <- paper_rows |>
  summarise(r = cor(concern, distrust_parl, use = "complete.obs"), .by = cntry) |>
  mutate(country = country_names[cntry]) |>
  arrange(r)
r_between <- paper_rows |>
  summarise(across(c(concern, distrust_parl), \(v) mean(v, na.rm = TRUE)), .by = cntry) |>
  summarise(r = cor(concern, distrust_parl)) |>
  pull(r)

# The curve of 192, ranked from the largest estimate (rank 1) to the smallest,
# as the Multiverse page draws it
curve <- read_csv(td("spec_curve.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE,
                  col_types = cols(stat_type = col_character())) |>
  arrange(desc(b)) |>
  mutate(rank = row_number())
curve_ref <- filter(curve, is_reference)
# The specification of the course closest to the model of 6U3LL: scales over
# the answered items, as in the file of the analysts
curve_analogue <- filter(curve, outcome == "parliament", controls == "paper", weights == "none",
                         items == "available", fe == "country_round")
# Placement as try_spec() prints it: the specifications with a larger estimate
placement_ref <- sum(curve$b > curve_ref$b + 1e-9)
by_set <- curve |>
  summarise(lo = min(b), hi = max(b), mean = mean(b), n_lo = min(n), n_hi = max(n), .by = controls)
bs <- \(set, col) by_set[[col]][by_set$controls == set]

# Share of the variance of the 192 estimates carried by each decision, from the
# sums of squares of a main-effects model; the residual holds the interactions
var_ss <- anova(lm(b ~ outcome + controls + weights + items + fe, data = curve))
var_share <- setNames(var_ss$`Sum Sq` / sum(var_ss$`Sum Sq`), rownames(var_ss))

analysts <- rd("analysts5.csv")
repro <- rd("display_reproduction.csv")
inference <- rd("display_inference.csv")
loo <- rd("display_loo.csv")
means <- rd("display_country_means.csv")
reliab <- rd("display_reliability.csv")
options_d <- rd("display_options.csv")
deviations <- rd("menu_deviations.csv")
menu_opts <- rd("menu_options.csv")

# The published result, the reproductions, the five reanalyses and the
# replications, each placed by its coefficient; rank is the count of
# specifications with a larger estimate, as for a class result
mark_tags <- c(OA = "OA 2012", SCORE_jp7tr = "SCORE jp7tr", SCORE_65wm6 = "SCORE e48gd",
               SCORE_1634 = "SCORE 2010", SCORE_65wm6_DAR = "SCORE 2010–18")
marks_all <- rd("reference_marks.csv") |>
  mutate(tag = coalesce(unname(mark_tags[id]), id),
         rank = map_dbl(b, \(x) sum(curve$b > x + 1e-9)) + 0.5,
         new_data = data == "new")

# One value of a record or display file, for inline use
an <- \(id_code, col) analysts[[col]][analysts$id == id_code]
mark_of <- \(id_code, col) marks_all[[col]][marks_all$id == id_code]
rp <- \(id_code, col) repro[[col]][repro$id == id_code]
inf <- \(start, col) inference[[col]][startsWith(inference$rule, start)]
opt <- \(option_code, col) options_d[[col]][options_d$option == option_code]
dev_of <- \(axis_code, option_code, col) {
  deviations[[col]][deviations$axis == axis_code & deviations$option == option_code]
}
alpha_of <- \(scale_code, cntry_code) reliab$alpha[reliab$scale == scale_code & reliab$cntry == cntry_code]
fmt_p <- \(p) if (p < 1e-4) "p < 0.0001" else paste("p =", fmt_num(p, 4))

# The curve, the marks and the class chart share one visual grammar: a plain
# blue for the marks of the curve, the four adjustment sets in the blues of
# the workspace figure, ink for the reference results
plain <- "#1f5fa8"
bronze <- "#8c5a10"
set_cols <- c(none = "#b3cde3", demog = "#6497c8", outlook = "#2166ac", paper = "#08306b")
set_labels <- c(none = "no controls", demog = "demographics", outlook = "outlook and ideology",
                paper = "controls of the paper")

# The curve of 192: one mark per specification, ranked by the estimate, an
# open circle for p < 0.05 with errors clustered by country and a cross
# otherwise. `colour_by` = "controls" colours the marks by the adjustment set.
# coord_cartesian() fixes the range, so that an overlay never rescales the
# axis between consecutive slides.
curve_base <- function(colour_by = NULL) {
  p <- ggplot(curve, aes(rank, b)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = grey_mid, linewidth = 0.4)
  p <- if (is.null(colour_by)) {
    p + geom_point(aes(shape = sig), colour = plain, alpha = 0.45, size = 2.4, stroke = 0.8)
  } else {
    p + geom_point(aes(shape = sig, colour = .data[[colour_by]]), alpha = 0.85, size = 2.4, stroke = 0.9) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = set_cols, labels = set_labels, breaks = names(set_cols), name = NULL)
  }
  p +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 1, `FALSE` = 4), breaks = c(TRUE, FALSE),
                       labels = c("p < 0.05", "p ≥ 0.05"), name = NULL, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 0.35, 0.05), labels = \(x) fmt_num(x, 2)) +
    labs(x = sprintf("specification, ranked by the estimate (%d)", nrow(curve)),
         y = "points of distrust\nper point of concern") +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 0.35), xlim = c(0, nrow(curve) + 1)) +
    theme_slide(15) +
    theme(legend.position = "top", legend.justification = "right",
          legend.margin = margin(0, 0, -6, 0))
}

# Reference results as ink marks on the curve, each joined by a thin line to a
# tag in the empty space below the curve, which falls from left to right. Marks
# with the same estimate to three decimals share a tag (the SCORE reproduction
# e48gd and N8P2J fitted the same model to the same file). The tags are stacked
# in the order of the marks, largest estimate on top, so that no two lines
# cross.
mark_layer <- function(m, label_x = 92, top = 0.228, gap = 0.024) {
  tags <- m |>
    mutate(spot = round(b, 3),
           label = if_else(new_data, paste0(tag, " (new data)"), tag)) |>
    summarise(rank = mean(rank), b = mean(b), label = paste(label, collapse = " · "),
              .by = c(spot, new_data)) |>
    arrange(desc(b)) |>
    mutate(lab_y = top - gap * (row_number() - 1))
  list(
    geom_segment(data = tags, aes(x = label_x + 1, xend = rank, y = lab_y, yend = b),
                 colour = "#9aa3ab", linewidth = 0.35, inherit.aes = FALSE),
    # a circle for the original data, a triangle for the replications
    geom_point(data = filter(tags, !new_data), aes(x = rank, y = b), shape = 1, colour = ink,
               size = 3.4, stroke = 1.1, inherit.aes = FALSE),
    geom_point(data = filter(tags, new_data), aes(x = rank, y = b), shape = 2, colour = ink,
               size = 3.2, stroke = 1.1, inherit.aes = FALSE),
    geom_label(data = tags, aes(x = label_x, y = lab_y, label = label), colour = ink,
               fill = "#FFFFFFE6", size = 3.5, linewidth = 0.2, hjust = 1,
               label.padding = grid::unit(2.5, "pt"), inherit.aes = FALSE)
  )
}

# The causal graph of Task 2, as R/dag_starter.R of the workspace draws it:
# concern and distrust on one line, the possible common causes above it, and
# the vote for a far-right party and the verdict on public services below it,
# each with arrows from both attitudes. The arrow of the claim is a dashed
# green line. With `view = "paper"`, the controls of the paper are boxed: the
# arrows out of the three common causes, whose paths the boxes close, turn
# pale, and the arrows into the two common effects, whose paths the boxes
# open, turn red.
dag_nodes <- tribble(
  ~name,        ~x,   ~y,
  "concern",    0,    0,
  "distrust",   4,    0,
  "background", 2,    2.5,
  "pessimism",  0.25, 1.35,
  "ideology",   3.75, 1.35,
  "far_right",  2,   -1.1,
  "services",   2,   -2.1
) |>
  mutate(half_w = 0.12 + 0.05 * nchar(name), half_h = 0.2,
         role = case_when(name == "concern" ~ "exposure", name == "distrust" ~ "outcome",
                          .default = "other"))

# how far along a unit vector (ux, uy) the edge of a box lies
to_edge <- \(ux, uy, w, h) pmin(w / pmax(abs(ux), 1e-9), h / pmax(abs(uy), 1e-9))

# Arrows between the boxes of the nodes, each stopped at the edge of both boxes
dag_segments <- function(edges, nodes) {
  tails <- select(nodes, from = name, x0 = x, y0 = y, w0 = half_w, h0 = half_h)
  heads <- select(nodes, to = name, x1 = x, y1 = y, w1 = half_w, h1 = half_h)
  edges |>
    left_join(tails, by = "from") |>
    left_join(heads, by = "to") |>
    mutate(len = sqrt((x1 - x0)^2 + (y1 - y0)^2),
           ux = (x1 - x0) / len, uy = (y1 - y0) / len,
           s0 = to_edge(ux, uy, w0, h0) + 0.03,
           s1 = to_edge(ux, uy, w1, h1) + 0.07,
           x = x0 + s0 * ux, y = y0 + s0 * uy,
           xend = x1 - s1 * ux, yend = y1 - s1 * uy)
}

trust_dag <- function(view = c("all", "paper")) {
  view <- match.arg(view)
  confounders <- c("background", "pessimism", "ideology")
  colliders <- c("far_right", "services")
  edges <- tibble(from = c(rep(confounders, each = 2), "concern", "distrust", "concern", "distrust"),
                  to = c(rep(c("concern", "distrust"), 3), "far_right", "far_right", "services", "services")) |>
    mutate(state = case_when(view == "all" ~ "plain",
                             from %in% confounders ~ "closed",
                             .default = "opened"))
  segs <- dag_segments(edges, dag_nodes)
  boxes <- filter(dag_nodes, name %in% c(confounders, colliders)) |>
    mutate(kind = if_else(name %in% confounders, "closed", "opened"))
  edge_cols <- c(plain = "grey40", closed = "grey82", opened = d_red)
  node_fill <- c(exposure = ncl_blue, outcome = burgundy, other = "grey45")
  p <- ggplot() +
    annotate("segment", x = 0.62, xend = 3.3, y = 0, yend = 0, colour = green, linewidth = 1.1,
             linetype = "22", arrow = grid::arrow(length = grid::unit(9, "pt"), type = "closed")) +
    annotate("text", x = 2, y = 0.24, label = "the claim", colour = green, fontface = "bold",
             size = 4.8) +
    geom_segment(data = segs, aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend, colour = state),
                 linewidth = 0.9, arrow = grid::arrow(length = grid::unit(8, "pt"), type = "closed")) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = edge_cols, guide = "none")
  if (view == "paper") {
    p <- p + geom_rect(data = boxes,
                       aes(xmin = x - half_w - 0.08, xmax = x + half_w + 0.08,
                           ymin = y - half_h - 0.1, ymax = y + half_h + 0.1),
                       fill = NA, colour = if_else(boxes$kind == "closed", ncl_blue, d_red),
                       linewidth = 1.2)
  }
  p +
    geom_label(data = dag_nodes, aes(x = x, y = y, label = name, fill = role), colour = "white",
               fontface = "bold", size = 5.6, linewidth = 0,
               label.r = grid::unit(5, "pt"), label.padding = grid::unit(6, "pt")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = node_fill, guide = "none") +
    coord_fixed(xlim = c(-0.7, 4.7), ylim = c(-2.5, 2.9)) +
    theme_void()
}

# The three readings of the controls of the paper, as the specification menu
# draws them: the common causes above, the far-right vote and the verdict on
# services below, as common causes (left), steps on the path from concern to
# distrust (centre), or consequences of both attitudes (right)
readings_nodes <- tribble(
  ~name,        ~x,   ~y,
  "concern",    0,    0,
  "distrust",   4,    0,
  "pessimism",  0.1,  1.6,
  "background", 2,    1.6,
  "ideology",   3.9,  1.6,
  "services",   1.2, -1.45,
  "far_right",  2.8, -1.45
) |>
  mutate(half_w = 0.1 + 0.055 * nchar(name), half_h = 0.24,
         role = case_when(name %in% c("concern", "distrust") ~ "attitude",
                          name %in% c("services", "far_right") ~ "disputed",
                          .default = "common"))
readings_disputed <- list(
  "Common causes" = c("services>concern", "services>distrust", "far_right>concern", "far_right>distrust"),
  "Steps on the path" = c("concern>services", "services>distrust", "concern>far_right", "far_right>distrust"),
  "Consequences of both" = c("concern>services", "distrust>services", "concern>far_right", "distrust>far_right")
)

dag_readings <- function() {
  shared_edges <- tibble(from = rep(c("pessimism", "background", "ideology"), each = 2),
                         to = rep(c("concern", "distrust"), 3), kind = "shared") |>
    bind_rows(tibble(from = "concern", to = "distrust", kind = "claim"))
  panel_levels <- names(readings_disputed)
  edges <- imap(readings_disputed, \(e, panel) {
    bind_rows(shared_edges,
              tibble(from = sub(">.*$", "", e), to = sub("^.*>", "", e), kind = "disputed")) |>
      mutate(panel = panel)
  }) |>
    bind_rows() |>
    dag_segments(readings_nodes) |>
    mutate(panel = factor(panel, levels = panel_levels))
  labels <- tidyr::crossing(readings_nodes, panel = factor(panel_levels, levels = panel_levels))
  ggplot() +
    geom_segment(data = edges, aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend, colour = kind),
                 linewidth = 0.7, arrow = grid::arrow(length = grid::unit(6, "pt"), type = "closed")) +
    geom_label(data = labels, aes(x = x, y = y, label = name, fill = role), colour = "white",
               fontface = "bold", size = 3.7, linewidth = 0, label.padding = grid::unit(3.5, "pt")) +
    facet_wrap(~panel, nrow = 1) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(claim = green, shared = "grey60", disputed = bronze), guide = "none") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(attitude = ncl_blue, common = "grey45", disputed = bronze), guide = "none") +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-0.7, 4.7), ylim = c(-1.85, 2)) +
    theme_void(base_size = 15) +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", colour = ncl_blue, size = 15, margin = margin(b = 6)),
          panel.spacing.x = unit(1.5, "lines"))
}
```
